# Security Policy

**PLEASE DON'T DISCLOSE SECURITY-RELATED ISSUES PUBLICLY.**

## Supported Versions

This package is pre-release and pinned to the MiniMailer **v1** API contract. Only the
latest release receives security fixes.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security-related issue in this SDK, email **hello@minimailer.app** rather
than opening an issue. All security vulnerabilities will be promptly addressed.

Please include:

- the SDK version and PHP version,
- a description of the issue and its impact,
- a reproduction case if you have one.

If the issue is in the MiniMailer **API or service** rather than this client library,
report it through the same address and say so — the fix ships server-side, not here.
